text:
laura_pm: Quick sync — we need to lock scope for the Recommend/Optimize engine (batching, caching, quantization recs + eval-triggered alerts). Customers keep asking for both hosted and private flow; need tradeoffs and launch criteria. Thoughts?

devin_sre: +1 on scope call. Big question: do we ship hosted-only for beta? Private customers will need no telemetry leakage, so separate path. Hosted-first seems faster.

sunita_ml: For the recommender we need at minimum: a profiler that captures seq length distribution, token throughput, request concurrency, per-token latency and cost estimates. Also an offline model that maps profiled workload -> suggested batch size, cache policy (prefix vs KV), and quant profile candidate. Need to flag quality risk for quant.

marc_eng: Important: recommendations should be read-only initially (UI + API) — no auto-apply. Implementing an auto-apply path for Dedicated/Private is higher risk (rollback, canary). Also need runtime hooks to surface current config and simulated cost delta before apply.

ashley_custsuc: From CS feedback: customers want two things first — simple token-cost estimate per route and an "audit-ready" recommendations report they can share with security/compliance. A one-click apply for Dedicated would be a huge sell but not required day 1.

laura_pm: Proposed MUST-HAVE for beta (hosted):
- Profiler CLI + lightweight agent to sample 1-24h workload (seq dist, concurrency, latency, token counts)
- Recommendation engine that outputs batch_size, cache_policy, quant_profile_candidates with expected token savings and estimated quality risk
- UI card + API to view/download recommendation report (csv/json)
- Eval-alert integration: hook into existing eval infra to run regression prompts when quant profile is applied in staging
- Launch metrics: expected token cost reduction >= 10% on target benchmarks; quality regression alert false-positive rate < 5%; no P95 latency regression > 10% after applying non-greedy recs.

(NICE-TO-HAVE for beta)
- One-click apply for Dedicated customers
- Private onboarding docs and KMS/HSM notes

devin_sre: Telemetry/privacy note — for Private we should support local-only profiling with an export/import recommendation bundle. Hosted profiler can send anonymized aggregates. Suggested telemetry schema (minimal):

```
{
  "model": "string",
  "route": "string",
  "sample_window_sec": "int",
  "seq_length_hist": "list[int]",
  "avg_concurrency": "float",
  "p50_latency_ms": "float",
  "p95_latency_ms": "float",
  "tokens_per_request_avg": "float"
}
```
CLI example for customers to run locally: `rwinfctl profile --model gpt-small --duration 1h --out profile.json`

sunita_ml: Eval-trigger design: when a rec proposes quantization, auto-schedule an eval job against the production prompt set + curated regression set. If regression > threshold (configurable, default 1%), mark as "needs human review". Also track historical model quality delta for each quant_profile so we can create trust scores.

marc_eng: Implementation notes: recommender can initially be rules + heuristics (cost model + simple simulated batch effects) to get us to beta. Later replace with a small supervised model trained on internal A/B test results. Avoid heavy dependencies for alpha. Also tie recommendations to model variants (float16, int8-llm, q4_0).

laura_pm: Timeline suggestion:
- 6 weeks: profiler + telemetry schema + basic rules-based recommender (hosted read-only) -> internal alpha
- 12 weeks: UI + API + downloadable reports + eval-alerts integration -> closed beta with 5 customers
- 20 weeks: one-click apply for Dedicated + private export/import workflows -> GA for enterprise customers

ashley_custsuc: Sounds reasonable. For enterprise GA we should include exportable audit logs and an "explain" section in the report that justifies the recommendation in plain English.

devin_sre: Small request: define SLO guardrail for recommending larger batches — eg. only recommend batch_size that keeps p95 latency within 10% of baseline for 95% of windows. Add simulation mode that replays profiler data through the runtime cost model.

sunita_ml: Agree. Also add a metric for "regression alert precision" to evaluate eval-triggered alerts. Target < 5% false positive by GA. We need baseline prompt sets from customers to seed evals — CS can help.

marc_eng: UX question — how do we surface uncertainty? Suggest show three tiers: conservative (safe), balanced, aggressive (biggest savings, higher risk). Each with expected token savings and confidence score.

laura_pm: Decision so far:
1) Launch hosted beta with profiler + rules recommender + UI + eval-alerts (read-only)
2) Prioritize audit report and token savings estimate for first release
3) Delay auto-apply and private fully-managed integration to GA
4) Track launch metrics: token reduction, latency SLOs, alert FP rate, adoption (# routes onboarded)

reactions: everyone :thumbsup: except marc_eng :thinking: (because of runtime complexity)

rwinf-bot: Created ticket RW-OPT-5421: "Optimize Recommend: Hosted beta telemetry + rules-based recommender" and added laura_pm, sunita_ml, marc_eng, devin_sre, ashley_custsuc to assignee list.

laura_pm: Thanks — I'll write the PRD draft and share a checklist tomorrow. Please add any missing launch criteria here.
